specificClaims: The first product line is presented in 1932.
The company name is derived from 'LEg GOdt' (play well).
The original woodworking factory burned down in a devastating fire in 1942.
The company doubled its sales during the first two years of World War II.

creative.headline: When a global crisis killed a carpenter's livelihood, he needed fast cash.
creative.subheadline: A desperate career pivot creates a global toy legacy.
creative.selectedPain: A carpenter loses his trade to an economic crisis.
creative.selectedProof: That desperate pivot launched the LEGO Group's enduring toy legacy.

scriptBeats.narration: When a global crisis killed a carpenter's livelihood, he needed fast cash.
Ole Kirk Kristiansen shifted from heavy ladders to small wooden toys.
He crafted easy-to-sell wooden cars, airplanes, and yoyos to survive.
That desperate pivot launched the LEGO Group's enduring toy legacy.
